test_title: PYST 9: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 14th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the sentences into a coherent paragraph:

1. This enables defining structure and behaviour in OOP.

2. OOP is based on “objects” containing data and code.

3. A “class” acts as a blueprint for objects.

4. This paradigm models real-world systems.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph explains the fundamentals of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and its structure.
 
• **Sentence 2 is the first sentence** as it introduces the concept of OOP:
 
 
• "OOP is based on “objects” containing data and code."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 3 follows** as it defines the role of a class in OOP:
 
 
• "A “class” acts as a blueprint for objects."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 1 is next** because it explains what this structure enables:
 
 
• "This enables defining structure and behaviour in OOP."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 4 concludes** by highlighting the real-world modelling capability of OOP:
 
 
• "This paradigm models real-world systems."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **2, 3, 1, 4**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"OOP is based on “objects” containing data and code. A “class” acts as a blueprint for objects. This enables defining structure and behaviour in OOP. This paradigm models real-world systems."
